flags.why: Tế bào niêm mạc means cells of the mucosal lining, rather than mucus-producing cells.
flags.fix: Cells of the mucosal lining undergo hyperplasia during prolonged inflammation.

flags.why: Incompatibility between medicines differs from contraindication, which the [Ministry of Health](https://ydct.moh.gov.vn/static/files/uploads/b6449d75410bc5e95467fe74a38ad5898c26fb6d7cfefe065df19063f0edcde3.pdf) lists separately.

Tương kị means incompatibility, whereas contraindication is chống chỉ định, a separate category in [Ministry of Health documentation](https://ydct.moh.gov.vn/static/files/uploads/b6449d75410bc5e95467fe74a38ad5898c26fb6d7cfefe065df19063f0edcde3.pdf).

The translation substitutes contraindications for incompatibilities, which [Ministry of Health documentation](https://ydct.moh.gov.vn/static/files/uploads/b6449d75410bc5e95467fe74a38ad5898c26fb6d7cfefe065df19063f0edcde3.pdf) treats separately.
flags.fix: Read the section on incompatibilities carefully before using the medicine.
